```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = 'C:/Users/griff/Downloads/Thunder Training Data')
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lightgbm)
library(pROC)
```


```{r}
train_df <- read_csv("training.csv.gz")
test_df  <- read_csv("testing.csv.gz")

combined_df <- bind_rows(
  train_df %>% mutate(is_train = 1),
  test_df %>% mutate(is_train = 0, outcome = NA)
)

combined_model_df <- combined_df %>% 
  mutate(
    approach_num = map(closestdefapproach, ~ as.numeric(str_extract_all(.x, "[0-9.]+")[[1]]))
  ) %>%
  unnest_wider(approach_num, names_sep = "_") %>%
  rename(
    def_dist_1s   = approach_num_1,
    def_dist_075s = approach_num_2,
    def_dist_05s  = approach_num_3,
    def_dist_025s = approach_num_4
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    contested = as.integer(contested),
    outcome = as.integer(outcome),
  shot_angle = atan2(locationy, locationx - (-41.75)),
  def_closing_speed = (def_dist_1s - def_dist_025s) / 0.75, 
  
  three = as.integer(three)) %>% 
  mutate(across(c(shottype, gamestate, month), as.factor))

full_train <- combined_model_df %>% filter(is_train == 1)
test_clean  <- combined_model_df %>% filter(is_train == 0)
```


```{r}
set.seed(42)
val_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(full_train)), size = 0.2 * nrow(full_train))

train_data <- full_train[-val_idx, ]
val_data   <- full_train[val_idx, ]

logit_model <- glm(
  outcome ~ num_contesters + contested + distance + shot_angle + three + gamestate + shottype + shotclock + dribblesbefore + closestdefdist + shooterspeed + def_closing_speed + def_dist_025s,
  data = train_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

summary(logit_model)

val_data$pred_logit <- predict(logit_model, newdata = val_data, type = "response")
```


```{r}
feature_cols <- c(
  "shot_angle", "locationx", "locationy", "three",
  "dribblesbefore", "shotclock", "shooterspeed", "closestdefdist",
  "def_closing_speed", "num_contesters", "contested", "shottype", 
  "gamestate", "shooter_id", "def_team_id", "off_team_id", "distance", "def_dist_025s"
)

dtrain_split <- lgb.Dataset(
  data = data.matrix(train_data[, feature_cols]),
  label = train_data$outcome,
  categorical_feature = c("shottype", "gamestate", "shooter_id", "def_team_id", "off_team_id")
)

params <- list(
  objective = "binary",
  metric = "binary_logloss",
  boosting = "gbdt",
  learning_rate = 0.05,
  num_leaves = 31,
  max_depth = 6,
  feature_fraction = 0.8,
  min_data_in_leaf = 50
)

cv_model <- lgb.cv(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain_split,
  nfold = 5,
  nrounds = 1000,
  early_stopping_rounds = 50,
  verbose = 0
)

final_lgb <- lgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain_split,
  nrounds = cv_model$best_iter
)

test_preds <- predict(final_lgb, data.matrix(test_clean[, feature_cols]))

calc_log_loss <- function(actual, pred) {
  eps <- 1e-15
  pred <- pmax(pmin(pred, 1 - eps), eps)
  -mean(actual * log(pred) + (1 - actual) * log(1 - pred))
}

loss_logit <- calc_log_loss(val_data$outcome, val_data$pred_logit)
loss_gbm   <- calc_log_loss(val_data$outcome, val_data$pred_gbm)

auc_logit <- auc(val_data$outcome, val_data$pred_logit)
auc_gbm   <- auc(val_data$outcome, val_data$pred_gbm)

comparison_df <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Logistic Regression", "LightGBM"),
  Log_Loss = c(loss_logit, loss_gbm),
  ROC_AUC = c(auc_logit, auc_gbm)
)
print(comparison_df)

threshold <- 0.5

val_data <- val_data %>%
  mutate(
    class_logit = if_else(pred_logit >= threshold, 1, 0),
    class_gbm   = if_else(pred_gbm >= threshold, 1, 0)
  )

acc_logit <- mean(val_data$class_logit == val_data$outcome)
acc_gbm   <- mean(val_data$class_gbm == val_data$outcome)

accuracy_df <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Logistic Regression", "LightGBM"),
  Log_Loss = c(loss_logit, loss_gbm),
  ROC_AUC = c(auc_logit, auc_gbm),
  Accuracy = c(acc_logit, acc_gbm)
)

print(accuracy_df)

```


```{r}
submission <- test_clean %>%
  select(shot_id) %>%
  mutate(make_prob = test_preds)

write.csv(submission, "griffin_submission.csv")
```
